meta.name: CCNL Cooperative e Consorzi Agricoli
meta.sector: cooperative e consorzi agricoli — impiegati e operai agricoli

sources.notes: Verbale di accordo 19/07/2024 All. n.1: tabelle retributive conglobate per 8 livelli (1-7+np), 4 tranches 2024-2027. Seniority: Art. 61 (operai) e Art. 49 (impiegati). Indennità funzione quadri Art. 45 rivisitata dal 01/08/2024.

notes.text: CCNL A016 — Cooperative e Consorzi Agricoli. Conglobated model. 8 livelli: np-7-6-5-4-3-2-1. Divisore 169, 14 mesi. 4 tranches: apr-2024, mag-2025, mag-2026, feb-2027.

Quadri: i livelli 1Q e 2Q del precedente impianto corrispondono a livello 1° e 2° con aggiunta dell'indennità di funzione quadri (Art. 45): 1Q +EUR 180→230/mese, 2Q +EUR 125→160/mese dal 01/08/2024. Modellata come fixed_allowance a 14 mensilità su ciascun livello.

SENIORITY: operai Art. 61 (max 5 biennali) e impiegati Art. 49 (max 12 biennali) hanno importi differenti per livelli 3-7. Operai amounts confirmed from rinnovo 2024 (lavoro-economia.it, businessonline.it): L7=9.44, L6=10.85, L5=11.39, L4=11.93, L3=12.20, L2=29.44, L1=33.05 EUR/biennio. Modelled with operai amounts (dominant workforce in cooperatives) and maximum_count=12 (impiegati cap). Queries for operai with seniority_count>5 will overstate by at most 1-5 scatti; this is a structural engine limitation (single seniority table per level).

limitation.remediation: Model the operai scatti (Art. 61, at most 5 biennali) apart from the impiegati scatti (Art. 49).

notes.text: Apprendistato: regola non reperita nel PDF 2024. Modellato come 100% passthrough.

limitation.remediation: Source the apprenticeship rule of the 2024 CCNL and model its track.

notes.text: APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: APPRENTICE INPS RATES: the apprentice rates of the sector (agricoltura) apply the 10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus the 1.61% NASpI, but no source found settles the disoccupazione and CISOA contributions of agricultural apprentices (INPS circ. 43/2026 gives no apprentice rates). The contributions of an apprentice may differ.

limitation.remediation: Source the apprentice rates of agricoltura (an INPS circular or an association table of 2026), mark the apprentice block of contribution/2026/agricoltura.json derived, then remove this note.

notes.text: OTD: a fixed-term operaio is paid the minimo conglobato giornaliero or orario plus a terzo elemento of 30.44% (festività 5.45%, ferie 8.33%, 13ma 8.33%, 14ma 8.33%) on 312 working days instead of the monthly payments (Art. 60, verbale 19 July 2024, p. 14); the engine pays the monthly structure.

limitation.remediation: Model the daily pay and the terzo elemento of the fixed-term operai, as the operai agricoli CCNL requires.

reviews.scope: Second review of the agricoltura group: minimi conglobati of the eight levels in the four tranches, monthly payments, fixed-term operai and scatti, against the signed verbale of 19 July 2024.
findings: The 32 minimi match the signed All. n. 1 (p. 19, a scanned page read from the image; each tranche equals the one before plus the printed aumento): verified.
14 monthly payments: the verbale names the 13ma and 14ma for the operai a tempo indeterminato (p. 14) but restates no clause for the impiegati: derived, no longer assumed.
Fixed-term operai are owed a terzo elemento of 30.44% instead of the monthly payments (p. 14): not modelled and not declared; now a limitation.
Scatti are not in the verbale: derived. The file applies the impiegati maximum of 12 to the operai, whose maximum is 5; the note said so but did not block: now a limitation from the 6th biennale.
